phrases.value: This is how you help me. You put money on yourself, sleep 7 hours, get a workout in, and your wearable decides.

And Spotter, our settlement agent, pays out. Your health data never touches the chain, only the result. So, everyone's stake's the same, and if you hit it, you get your stake back, plus a share of what the people who missed put in.
Miss it, and your wearable shows it. Your stake goes to the people who hit. No data, and you get it back.
Nobody gets burned by a sync bug. Before you play, you make your player ones. World ID proves that I'm one real human, so nobody farms entities with extra wallets.
Each person proves once, and that's the point.
I'm verified, and my name is andre.gohealthme.ath, and you can ENS V2 name on Sepolia, and my whoop is paired. Last night I joined this one workout challenge, did a walk, and spotter read my whoop.
Before paying it asked me to confirm it was really me. With my world ID. My first request expired and nothing moved.
That is the safety net. I confirmed the second, and Interceptor screened my wallet against sanctions list, and it recorded on chain, banked.
And these ones here are live right now. Same stake, and I missed go sign. Users can create their own challenges to achieve their various health goals.
And right now we're offering verification through your wearables on sleep and workout activity. This is our continuity build. V1 won at ETH Global New York, and V3 was a pilot on base.
And this weekend we added world ID, ENS names, and interceptor screening, and made the commitment model rail. It's in beta on base Apolia test money.
